notes.title: SONG of IRON Dec 16 patch "Performance Improvements"
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update has been a long time coming! I have been very hard at work to make major improvements to performance along with upping the visual fidelity of the game.  I am very happy to be getting this out to everyone before the end of the year! 

--- Performance Improvements---

- Major performance improvements should have players seeing vastly improved frame rate along with a much smoother play experience.
- Huge lighting update across the game that both improves the visuals but also improves performance.  Most noticeable darker areas lit by things other than the sun. 
-visual updates to a number of areas including the starting level. 
- Frame rates are much more consistent and smooth, dug deep into the game systems to clean up hitches and overall bad performance. 
- Game now defaults to 90fps

---Gameplay improvements--- 

- Stamina rework, putting the focus on combat and removing it from climbing and running. 
- low stamina slows down attack speed ( true before but its a bit more significant now.)
- fixed a number of small bugs with ai that helps clean up the fights a bit
-Number of small fixes to improve quality of life throughout the game. 
-Added middle mouse as additional "Interact" key bind. this helps some less than ideal moments of finger yoga that can happen. 

--- other ---
- Game install size has been reduced by more than half! 

Cheers!
Joe

notes.title: Week 2 Update 1.0.6.5 Achievements!!!

Song of Iron Update 1.0.6.5

- Achievements are now live! 
- Improved the Health/Stamina/Mana Bar readability. 
- More localization fixes, All languages have now been updated.  ( few little bugs to track down still )

notes.title: Developer update sept 15
notes.notes:
[i]UPDATE : Patch is now lIve!!![/i]

Hey everyone!  Its been 2 weeks now since Song of Iron launched and while things are calming down some I am still hard at work on the next Patch! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36948613/4f366f7eda12983ffa2252b1e0dde1a9dfe37379.png[/img]



Working on all sorts of little fixes and the like for this patch but here are a few notable things to look for.

[u][b]Achievements. [/b][/u]
Today Achievements will start to be visible, but you wont be able to get them just yet. I have to publish the achievement list in order to do the final tests on them.  Very sorry for any confusion here, but I am hopeful I can get through this testing quickly and get the full patch out soon. 

[u][b]Updated heath/Stamina/Mana bars[/b][/u]
While hunting down some bugs I took a little bit of time to tidy up the status bar UI to making things much easier to understand at a glance while maintaining as low a profile as possible.  

[u][b]Performance[/b][/u]
Small note, but few more things have been found on the performance side that should help a little bit 

[b][u]Lightning activation[/u][/b]
Some people have reported issues activating the lighting abilities so making a few tweaks to try and improve this. 


I don't want to set a hard date on the next patch but I am hopeful that I can get through the achievement testing quickly so hoping it is ready this week some time.  

Thank you as always for all the support! It is just myself working on this so updates are a bit slower than the average game but I will keep pushing to fix issues and improve the experience. The positive community support really make that so much more rewarding. 

Best 
Joe

notes.title: Launch day + 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone. Wow what a day that was. First I want to thank everyone who picked up the game on launch day. It means the world to me Indie dev is a wild ride and I honestly appreciate the support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36948613/973768e2733a866a9137496d7356085c4cdbae3c.jpg[/img]

Not everything went so well however and I clearly have some things I need to fix. I am very sorry to anyone who ran into any of these issues. The fault is mine and I will be working hard to amend that. 


This is not everything on my list but is currently the highest priority issue. 

[u][b]Updating the localization.[/b][/u] Believe it or not I did hire a group to help me with this but it's looking like that didn't go so well.  Luckily I have a fantastic community and a number of people have volunteered to help me out. all localizations will be getting improvements soon!

[b][u]Controls not working, [/u][/b] In some cases players are finding that they cannot move left or right and when trying to change the input the game crashes.  luckily I have a work around for this while I try to find a solution. ( again thanks to a community member) 

1. Uninstall the game
2. go to my users > [name] > AppData > Local folder and delete the SONG_of_IRON folder
3. Re-install

[u][b]Quality of life fixes.[/b][/u]
- Thrown weapon does not always return
- UI needs some general improvements such as hitting Esc to quickly exit or B on a gamepad backing out of the current window. 
- improving the readability of some areas or puzzles. (I hoped a more subtle touch would be enough in most cases but looks like there are a few areas that could use a bit more help)
- Controls stop working in some rare cases ( rolling or crouching will fix) 

Again this is just the beginning but Wanted to let everyone know that I am aware and working to fix issues that are coming up! I will try to post updates to this fairly frequently as I work through them. 

Thank you so much for understanding. 

Joe

notes.title: Song of Iron Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Gather round, Warriors! 

I am so incredibly excited to announce that Song of Iron will launch on [b]August 31st  2021[/b]!

It has been a crazy 2 year journey. Thank you for sticking with me, I can’t wait to get into your hands! To celebrate this announcement, I am excited to share a brand new launch date announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=i_RjazSKQY8;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What can I expect from the game? [/b]

Song of Iron is an intense side scrolling action adventure, set in a dark Nordic world. Your journey to save your people will lead you into hard hitting visceral combat with man and monster alike, through many beautiful forests, caves, mountain tops and into a mystery that runs through the entire world.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36948613/50a2adb5aff37248a0c5e666abb472bea8d470f7.png[/img]

Song of Iron has a beautiful original soundtrack to further bring you into the Nordic atmosphere.  

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36948613/5ceb02b29f3ca9248025904f532a2efc0414c232.png[/img]

You will be immersed into daunting old growth forests, deep forbidden caves, windswept and icy mountains, and so much more! You'll be taking on the vast world of Song of Iron, all while learning how to skillfully bash, climb, sneak, hack and burn your way across the provoking and shadowy Nordic world.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36948613/9bca56aa9e1009d80d2eb26fc3e2ab9fdaea7fff.png[/img]

Want to know more? Stay up to date on my  latest game development story, and insights on my [url=https://discord.gg/pjgzk3Fkyz]Discord community[/url] of hardened Vikings; where key giveaways, developer livestreams and more will take place around release.

Song of Iron will be priced at $19.99 and is available to wishlist on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258220/Song_of_Iron/?beta=0]Steam[/url] now! 

Till next time!

notes.title: Song of Iron Demo is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello, warriors! 

The time has come! The Song of Iron Demo is now LIVE and playable on the Steam store page, exclusively in Steam’s Next Fest until June 22nd. 

[b]What can I expect in this Demo?[/b]

Enjoy breathtaking action-platformer gameplay, with updated mechanics, improved graphics, new tracks, but most importantly, the beginning of the story that will drive your adventure!  I really wanted to give you all a good look at what you can expect, when the full game releases later this year. 

For those who had played the game in the past, fear not. This is the perfect opportunity to see the progress Song of Iron has made. In large part, thanks to the feedback given after the first demo!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36948613/6da24d8515ff8d4147d9aba37710a86b8e418a58.png[/img]

[b]Demo Availability[/b]

Starting NOW and ending June 22nd

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36948613/2d04957ee93038f8c13aae22c647dfdfe482f96d.png[/img]

[b]How do I play it? [/b]

To download the Demo, simply go to Song of Iron’s Steam page and click the button at the top of the game's description.

Before you download and play, I’d love to invite you to my great hall on Discord, where other warriors currently gather and bang their shields, in preparation for the 16th!

Here you can leave feedback, share your progress and discuss the game’s story in more detail. 

You can also follow me on Twitter, Facebook and Instagram for the latest news, Demo patches and more. 

Cheers!

Joe
